fnol_text: My name is Noor Achebe and I live at 406 Willow Terrace, Greenville, SC 29654. You can reach me on (555) 760-9499 or noor.achebe@example.com. We had a cloudburst on 25 June 2025. The drains in the street could not cope and surface water from the road came up the drive and into the ground floor through the front door. Policy HH-2024-00149. I'd like to claim for the damage to my home. Am I insured for this or not?

adjuster_notes.text: Called Ms Achebe on (555) 760-9499 to acknowledge the claim. Noor confirmed the loss date as 25 June 2025.
Site visit to 406 Willow Terrace. Neighbour Declan Achebe was present and confirmed the timeline.
Noor sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
